message: player_4, I'm not part of your follow result, so I can't confirm it either way. player_3 and player_4 each have a result that contradicts the other. The simplest test is for player_3 to name exactly who they watched and whether any visitor came to player_4's door that night, so we can check it against your follow destination.

Night 2 I followed player_9 and they went to player_4. Player_4 was then struck by a sigil, so that visit fits a sigilist placing a sigil better than an investigator check on them. I have no vote lean yet, so I want to hear from player_1, player_5, player_7 and player_8 first.

player_10, you say player_7 visited no one on night 3, but player_7 now calls the announced check a slip and says they held. Player_3 and player_10, name your night 3 watch or follow target now, so tomorrow's morning report can test both claims.

Player_7 says they checked player_5 on night 3, but player_5 was killed that night, so that claim is hard to test. Player_8, you said player_7 checked you on night 1, but player_7 says that check was on player_10. Which night was your check, player_7? Vote-wise I'm open for now and want a concrete answer before anyone is lynched.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so you're right that I visited them. That same follow saw player_7 go to player_8, which fits their night-2 check on player_8. But on night 3 I followed player_7 and they visited no one, so the check on player_5 they announced didn't happen. player_7, which is it?

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did come to them, and I saw them go to player_8. player_7, on night 3 I followed you and you visited no one, so your check on player_5 didn't happen. Player_3, what did your watch on player_7 show on night 3?

I'm the trailseer. Last night I followed player_9 and they went to player_4, who died as the chanteuse. player_9, you claimed investigator, so who did you check and what came back? I'm not voting anyone yet, since I've got nothing solid on the rest.

Both player_3 and player_10 put a visit on player_7 on night 2, and that fits the save. player_7, you held the last check on night 3, so say plainly what you'd check on a split and when. player_8, what exactly did player_7 tell you about night 1?
(passed)

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_8: not suspicious, so player_8 isn't a wolf. Player_3 says no one visited player_4, and player_4 says player_3 visited them; they can't both be right, and a follow shows where someone went, not who came to your own door. player_4, if you followed player_3, who visited you?
(passed)

My trailseer follow on night 2 was player_9, and they visited player_4, who was then struck down by a sigil. If player_9 is a real investigator, the check must come from a visit, so I want to see who they say they checked. player_9, which night did you check and on whom?

player_4, I wasn't following anyone that night, so your follow result can't be a true read on me going to your door. You say the wording is exact, so tell us what else that result listed. If it named only me, it's a claim I can't back up.

Player_3 was killed by the wolves on night 4, and player_1 is the one who visited player_3 that night. player_1, what did you do there, and were you blocked? I'd vote player_1 today unless they can explain that visit.

player_4, a follow shows where the followed player went, so your result would be 'player_3 visited player_4'. Which night did you follow player_3, and did you have any other visit that night? player_3 says they never went to you. One of your results must be misread, and that is checkable.

player_4, I'm not going to dispute your follow; I'm not the one who visited your door. I'm the Vigilante, and I held fire on night 1, so I shot no one. player_3 and player_4 can't both be right, so I'd test which of them is lying before anyone votes.

I'm the Healer, and on night 1 I protected player_10 with no save announced. Note the sigil claim from player_8 matches the record: player_1 died to a sigil. For the follow/watch dispute, player_3 claims the empty watch while player_4 claims a visit, so one of the two results has to be wrong. I'd test player_8 and player_5's checks before voting.

player_4, that visit was me: I watched you on night 1, and a watch is a visit, so you saw me there. Nothing came to you that night. I'm the sentinel, and I still have one watch left. Player_5, player_6 and player_8 have all claimed roles, so I'll weigh them before I decide where to watch next.
player_7, you said last night's check would go on player_5. What came back? Reporting a result is cheap to check against the dead roster, so give the reading and say whether the check was made.

I'm player_5, and I checked player_8 night 1: Not suspicious. player_8 says the sigil was theirs, which fits. player_4 and player_3 contradict each other about a visit to player_4's door. Who can tell me which of their two claims has a witness? Until that's settled I won't vote on either.
(passed)
I'll go first with a result: I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, and they went to player_7. Since player_6 was the sentinel, player_7 should say what that visit was about.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did go to them; that was my only visit there. My follow saw player_7 go to player_8 that night, which fits their check claim. But player_7 said they checked player_5 on night 3, and my follow saw no visit, so that check didn't happen. player_7, which night did your last check actually happen?
(passed)

I'm the trailseer, and with both wolves gone I'll share my follows. Night 5 I followed player_6 and they visited no one. My night 2 follow on player_7 went to player_8, which fits player_7's check. player_8 claims sigilist but has placed nothing in four nights, so I'm voting player_8 for now.

My vote today is player_1. They claim sigilist and say a sigil on player_3 did nothing on night 4, but player_3 was killed by a wolf that same night, so that account needs a reason. Player_10's follow shows player_1 at player_3's door, and player_1 has not said what they did there beyond the claim. player_1, who visits a wolf's target and says it did nothing?

I'd vote player_1 today. A night-4 sigil that struck nobody is a wasted use, and it's the only thing that puts player_1 at player_3's door. player_10's follow lines up with player_3's watch, so I'd rather hear player_6 account for night 3 before anything else.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so you saw me there. player_7, that night I saw you go to player_8, which fits your check. But last night I followed you and you visited no one, so the night-3 check on player_5 didn't happen. Which night did you actually check?

player_7, on day 3 you planned a night-3 check on player_5, who died that night. What did that check read? Your check results are the only test of the healer claim right now, so give the result, not the plan. I'm abstaining on today's vote until we have that.

The record says player_1 carried the kill on night 1, so player_8's sigil claim fits. player_5, your check on player_8 is worth tracking if player_8 is a real sigilist. player_4, if you followed player_3, you would only see where player_3 went, so your 'player_3 visited me' line is the thing to explain.

player_7, you said your last check would go on player_5 last night, but you made no visit at all on night 3. So that check did not happen. Explain why you said you would check player_5 and then did not.
Yes, I went to you last night, player_4. Nobody else came to your door that I saw. I'm not showing more than that yet, so let's see whose claims hold up.
I'm the trailseer. I followed player_6 last night and they visited player_7. That's the only hard thing I have. player_7, what did you get on night 1, and did anyone come to you?

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did come to them, which matches your watch. That follow showed player_7 went to player_8, matching their night-2 check claim. player_7, my night-3 follow on you saw no visit, so your check on player_5 didn't happen. Which is it?

player_4, your result is false. I know for a fact nobody came to your door on night 1, so there was no visit to read. Say what you think you saw and where the follow came from, or the lie is yours to carry.

Yes, player_3, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did visit them. My follow that night showed player_7 going to player_8, not anyone going to player_5. Last night I followed player_7 again and they visited no one, so a check on player_5 from them didn't happen. player_7, which is it?

player_3, yes, my night-2 follow was on player_7, so I was there, and that's the only visit I made. player_7, you said you checked player_5 on night 3. I followed you that night and you visited no one, so that check didn't happen. Which is it?

I'm not going to vouch for anyone's door. player_4, you've given the same follow result twice, but player_3 has given a watch result that says the opposite, and one of you is off. I'll say my own night: I'm the Vigilante, and I held my shot on night 1. player_7 has been unusually silent and is the one nobody has tested, so I'd test them before the vote.

I'm the investigator. Night 1 I checked player_10, night 2 player_8, both Not suspicious. I had no checks on night 3, so my day 3 talk of checking player_5 was wrong, I had none left. Player_10, nothing I did last night touches your follow, so test your read on who visited me instead.

player_7, you said your last check would go on player_5, but player_5 died to the wolves that night. What did that check read, and who did you visit on night 3? Nobody can test the investigator claim until you answer that.

player_1, the only sigil story so far is yours, and a sigil that found no attack on player_3 tells us nothing. player_10, what did your night-3 follow on player_7 show? If player_1's night-4 visit is real, I'd like to see how it lines up with player_3's dead roster. My vote would go to player_1 for now.

player_7, you said last day you'd check player_5 on night 3, but player_5 was killed by the wolves and no check result came out. Did you actually use that check, and on who? Answer that before anyone votes on player_8 or player_9.

player_3's night-2 watch lines up with the record: player_2 was the wolf attacking player_7 and player_5 was the healer who saved them. That makes player_3's report the most checked so far. player_10, what did your night-1 follow show? That's an untested claim we can check.

My night 5 follow on player_6 saw no visits, so player_6 has still given us nothing. player_8 is the only one with a role claim we can test, so I'll follow player_8 tonight and see whether any visit shows up. If it shows nothing either, I'd vote player_8 on the day 6 vote.

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_8: not suspicious. player_3, you said you visited no one, but a sentinel watch is a visit, so which is it? player_4's follow result showing a visit to them fits player_3 watching them, so I lean toward player_4 being straight. I'd vote player_3 today unless that gets explained.

player_10, the 'only unkillable body is the Necromancer' step is weak: a sigil death on night 1 tells us the struck player attacked, not who is unkillable. I did nothing on night 1, so I have no result to offer. Who did player_8 sigil, and what did player_6 see when protecting player_10?

player_4, I did not go to your door on night 1, and I can say flatly that nobody did. So your follow result cannot be right, whatever the wording. Either the result is invented or it names someone else. Explain where that line came from, and stop repeating the same sentence.
(passed)
(passed)

player_7, you said your last check went on player_5 last night. What did you get back, or were you blocked? Your night-2 check on player_8 is still the only one you have a result for, so I want to know if the night-3 one actually happened before I vote.
player_1, I am the sigilist, and I placed no sigil on anyone on any night. Your sigilist claim is false, so your sigil on player_3 on night 4 did not happen. I vote player_1 today.

player_4, your claim is the problem: a follow shows where the followed player went, so your result should read as player_3 going to someone, not as a visit to your door. Quote the exact text and say whether it named a destination. player_6, if you protected player_10 on night 1, nobody attacked them, so that save proves nothing either way.
(passed)

Player_2 is dead, and my night-2 watch on player_7 saw player_2, player_5 and player_10 come to them. Since player_5 is the healer, the attacker was player_2 or player_10, and that makes player_10 the one living suspect from that visit. player_10, what did you go to player_7 for on night 2?

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, so I have no night result to offer. Sigil on a wolf, plus an unkillable pack target, is a stretch to pin on the one player who was quiet. I'd rather see who backs their follow claim against what player_4 said first.

player_10, I did not visit anyone on night 2 for a trailseer to see; I had a check on player_8 that night, so I was out. I have no checks left, so my night 1 and 2 reads on player_10 and player_8 are all I have, both Not suspicious. Your trailseer claim is testable: who did you follow on night 3?

Yes, I was at your door last night, player_4, and nothing came to you that night. I'm not going to say more about my night yet. Let's see who makes checkable claims today so we can test them against each other.

I'm the sigilist, so player_1's claim is false. I placed no sigil on night 4 and kept both. player_1, if you went to player_3 on night 4, what did you actually do there? A sigil claim that had no effect means you were not the one with the sigil.

player_10, I didn't check anyone on night 3. I had no checks left, so my day-3 plan to check player_5 was wrong and I shouldn't have said it. My two checks were night 1 on you and night 2 on player_8, both Not suspicious. If you were following me, you saw me visit no one, which fits. Which of player_3's or your claims do you think the morning report backs up?
Sharing my night 2 follow: I followed player_9 and they went to player_4, nobody else. player_9, if you checked someone last night, who was it? Player_2 is dead, so that check can't be tested now.
Night 4 I followed player_1 and saw them go to player_3, who the wolves killed that night. player_1, what did you do there? Until you answer, you are my vote if one were held now.

Player_8's sigil claim fits the record, and my check on player_8 was Not suspicious, so they are not a wolf. The player_3 and player_4 dispute is the thing to resolve: player_4 says player_3 visited, player_3 says a watch found no visitors. I'd lean toward testing player_3's claim, since a Sentinel watch and a Trailseer follow cannot both be right. I'm open to a vote on player_4 if nothing better shows up.

player_3, you watched player_7 on night 2 and saw player_2, player_5 and player_10 come. Did you watch anyone on night 3, and if not, why? player_10, your night-3 follow on player_7 is the only direct test of player_7's check claim, so keep that result exact.

player_4's follow claim only says player_3 went to them, and player_3 denies holding any follow. Only one player can hold the Trailseer, so player_4 needs to say what they can prove. player_3, which role do you hold? Your answer narrows who could have visited player_4's door.

I'm the trailseer, and I'll share my follows. Night 4 I followed player_1 and they went to player_3. Night 5 I followed player_6 and they visited no one. player_8 says they're the sigilist but placed nothing, so that claim is untested. I'd vote player_8 unless someone can show a sigil.

player_10, I'm not sitting on anything. I did nothing on night 1 and have no result to share. Pushing a vote onto me on a theory about who can't be killed on night one is thin. Who do you think is lying in the player_3/player_4 fight, and why?

player_4, I didn't push on silence. The sigil killed player_1 and no bite landed, so the only body that could take that attack and survive night one is the Necromancer. That's deduction from the night report, not a hunch about who talks least. player_3 and player_4 can keep fighting over the follow, but that doesn't clear anyone.

player_10, you went to player_7 on night 2. What did you do there, and what came of it? player_7, your night-3 check on player_5 never got a chance to come back, so what did you learn from the other checks? I'd vote player_10 today until they answer.

Player_7's night-3 check on player_5 is the only test we have, so let's see that result before any lynch. If I had to vote now it's player_10: they pushed the check timeline against player_7 on day 3 and the night-2 attack on player_7 was saved, so the pressure on the investigator looks like cover. Who has a night-3 result to share?

player_4, you and player_3 cannot both be right about a follow, so the next thing to check is whether anyone else saw a visit at player_3's door. Until someone adds a result, I'd treat the follow claim and the denial as equally unproven.

Correction: I have no checks left, so my night-3 check on player_5 never happened. My two checks were night 1 on player_10 and night 2 on player_8, both Not suspicious, as I said before. player_10, which night did you follow me? If it was night 3, then yes, I visited no one, as you said.

I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, who went to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who went to player_4. player_9 claimed investigator, so a check on player_4 would have come back Suspicious. Living players, who did you check or follow last night?

I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, who went to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who went to player_4. player_9, you claimed investigator: who did you check last night, and what did you get?
(passed)

Worth noting: player_6's night 1 protection on player_10 and player_8's sigil on player_1 both fit the record, but nothing tests either yet. If player_6 protects again tonight, and player_8 keeps one sigil, the next attack or sigil result will show who is telling the truth.

I followed player_9 last night and they went to player_4, who was then struck down by a sigil. Player_9, if you're the investigator, who did you check last night? Your claim is only useful if you name a target.

player_8's sigil claim fits the record: player_1 died to a sigil and the sigil only strikes a carrier, so player_1 was the night 1 pack carrier. player_4 should answer plainly whether they saw player_3 at their door or went to player_3, since those are different results.

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, so I have no result to give anyone and I'm not claiming a role yet. The sigil-struck death doesn't point at me; I'd rather see who backs up their night claims before we vote anyone. What do you base the push on besides the kill?

Player_10 visited player_7 on night 2, and player_2 was the other visitor. Player_7 says they checked player_5 last night, and player_5 is dead, so ask player_7 what the check returned. That is a test we can all see.

Two different nights are in play for the check on player_8. player_7 says night 2, and player_8 says night 1. player_10's follow puts player_7 at player_8 on night 2, which fits player_7's account. player_8, what night was the check, and what did you say to player_7 then?

Night 1 I checked player_10, Not suspicious. Night 2 I checked player_8, Not suspicious. I had no checks left on night 3, so nothing went to player_5. My day-3 'last check on player_5' line was a mistake, since both checks were already spent. Your follow on me showing no visits fits that I did nothing that night.

player_4, your follow of player_3 can't be checked, while player_3's watch on you saw no visitors. A fake follow is the only way both can be true, so I'd vote player_4 today. I'm not claiming anything yet.

I'm the trailseer. I followed player_6 last night and they visited no one. player_6 hasn't claimed a role, so unless they explain their night, I'd vote player_6 today. player_8's sigil claim is still unchecked by my follows.

Yes, I came to your door last night, player_4, and I'm keeping what I did there to myself for now. Going to you tells you nothing about whether you're a wolf. If you're the Trailseer, who else did you follow, and where did they go?
(passed)

player_4, I raised player_7 because the only death was a sigil and the Necromancer is the one body that can't die on night one, not because of silence. Your follow dispute matters more. If you followed player_3, where did player_3 go, and did anyone else visit you?

I'm the trailseer, and I'll say it now. Last night I followed player_1, and they visited player_3, the player who was killed by the wolves. That makes player_1 the likely chanteuse, since the wolves' last living member had to make that kill. player_1, what did you do on night 4?

player_4, I did not follow anyone and I did not visit you last night. Whoever you think visited you, it wasn't me, so your claim doesn't fit. Who do you think followed you, and what else did you learn?
Night 4, I followed player_1 and they went to player_3, who the wolves killed that night. Player_1, what did you do there? I'm voting player_1 today until that visit is explained.

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_8: not suspicious. Player_4, your follow says player_3 came to you, but player_3's watch says no one came. Player_3, you first said you visited no one, then said you watched player_4. Which one is it? I'd vote player_4 today unless that gets explained.

I'm the Healer; I protected player_10 on night 1, no save was needed. The player_3/player_4 dispute is the real test: player_3 says a watch on player_4 showed no visitor, but a Sentinel who visited would have been seen by its own watch only if watched; player_4's follow names player_3. Both can't stand. I'd vote on whichever of them fails that check.

player_7 said last night they would check player_5, but they went nowhere that night, so that check did not happen. Their night-2 check on player_8 and the night-3 plan don't line up with that. I'd vote player_7 unless someone can show why their check claims hold.

player_7, you said you planned a check on player_5 last night, but I followed you and you visited no one. Did the check happen? If you didn't check, your claimed night 3 result is not real and player_8's night 1 account stands. Name who you checked and what you read.

player_4, you asked what I did at your door: I didn't go there, and I'm not going to make up a story to fit your follow. Your result says player_3 visited you, and player_3 says they watched you and saw no one. One of you is wrong about the direction, so I'd test that before pushing silence on player_7.
player_3, you came to me last night. What did you do on night 1? Nobody has a result to trade yet, so let's hear the night 1 actions before the vote.

Night 2 is mostly settled: player_10's follow and player_7's check both put player_7 at player_8. Player_3, your watch saw three visitors, so which one was the wolf carrier? Player_7, the night-3 plan you announced is still the open part, so give the one-line version of what you did that night.

I'm not picking a side on wording alone. player_3 and player_4 can't both have the full story, and each has now quoted their result the same way. Whoever holds a real watch or follow should say which night the result covers, so we can check it against the other claim.

player_3, my night-2 follow on player_7 is a visit, so your watch seeing me is accurate on that. player_7, last night I followed you and you visited no one, so the night-3 check on player_5 you announced did not happen. Which night was your check really on?
Last night I followed player_6 and they went to player_7. player_7, did anyone come to you, or did you see anything? Who else has a night result they can check against that?

player_4, your follow and visit wording still conflicts; a follow shows where the target went, so ask player_3 where they went that night, not whether they came to you. player_8, the sigil claim fits the record, so check it against player_6's protection on night 1, which could have saved player_1.

player_3 and player_4 can't both be right about night 1, so the cheapest test is whether player_4 names a result player_3 can't dispute. I'm holding my check for now. Let's see whether player_6's Healer claim holds up before voting on anyone.

Night 3 is the cleanest test here. player_10's follow on player_7 saw no visits, so no check went out on player_5. player_3, if your watch lasted that night, who came to you? A watch that saw nobody would clear your claim against the wolf visit on player_5.

Record for me: I'm the Healer, and night 1 I protected player_10 with no public save, so player_10 is either unattacked or the unkillable Necromancer. player_3's watch on player_4 should have shown player_3 as a visitor if player_3 went there, so one of the two claims is false. I'd vote player_3 for now because their Sentinel claim fails on its own terms.
(passed)

Facts so far: player_1 died to a sigil, so player_1 attacked on night 1, and player_8's sigil claim fits that. Two roles still unclaimed: sentinel and trailseer. player_2 and player_7, do either of you hold one? If so, say what you did last night and who you saw, so we can test player_4's follow against it.

player_10, I'm not the one who has to be hung for a quiet first night. Nobody is cleared by an unannounced attack, and a sigil on a wolf carrying the kill is what killed player_1. Who do you think carried that kill, and why do you want the vote on me before player_3 and player_4 settle their wording?

player_4, you said your result read 'player_3 visited player_4', which is a watch result, yet you claim to have followed. A follow shows where the target went, so the wording can't be both. player_8, your sigil claim fits the record, so I'd like player_5's check and player_6's protection to stay consistent with it.

player_4, I won't say what I did at night, so I'm not going to call your follow false. My own watch never shows in my result, so a visit to your door could be real. Let's test the claims instead: player_8 says the sigil was theirs, and player_5 and player_6 each claim a role. Those three should be checked against each other before anyone votes.

I'm the sigilist, player_8, and I placed no sigil on anyone. player_1, your sigil claim on player_3 is false, so explain how a sigil you say you placed on night 4 had no effect. I'd vote player_1 today. player_10, your night-4 follow of player_1 can be checked against player_1's story.
(passed)

I'm the Healer; I protected player_10 on night 1 and nothing was announced, so that tells us little. The sigil claim from player_8 fits player_1 carrying the pack kill, which makes player_8 worth checking. I'd vote on the player_3 and player_4 contradiction, since one of them is lying about a visit to player_4's door.

Someone I saw went to player_7 on night 2, and that someone was player_10. player_7 says they checked player_10 on night 1 and it read clean, so player_7 should explain why player_10 went to them the next night. I would vote player_10 today on that visit.

player_1, you went to player_3 on night 4, and player_3 was killed by the wolves that night. What did you do there? Your answer is the first thing I want to test today. I'm not voting yet, so I'm abstaining until someone gives a result to check.

I'll say it since the floor's open: I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, and they went to player_7. player_6 is dead now, so player_7 should say what they know about that visit before we decide who to trust.

My follow on player_6 last night shows they visited no one, and no one died, so nothing from that night yet. player_8, you say you placed no sigil on nights 1 to 4, so what does the sigilist claim do for us? Name a target and result, or I'm voting you today.

player_4, I did not go to your door on night 1, so the visit you describe cannot be real. A follow result naming me is false, and that's a fact I can stand on. Tell us your claimed role and exactly where your night 1 follow went, and why you think I'd be the one at your door.

Night 4 I followed player_1, and they went to player_3. I'm not sure what that visit was, so player_1, what did you do there? player_6 and player_8, I'd like to hear your night 4 story too, since the only thing I can confirm is that visit.

player_1, you say you were a sigilist on player_3 on night 4, but the wolves killed player_3 that night, so a sigil there would have had no reason to trigger. Tell us where you went on nights 2 and 3, and what your sigil did, so player_10's follow can be checked against it. I'd vote player_1 today unless that account lines up.

I'm the trailseer, so here are my follows. Night 1 I followed player_6, who went to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who went to player_4. player_9 is dead, so that investigator claim is hard to test. player_7 was visited by a dead sentinel on night 1, so I'd like to hear what they say about that. I'm not voting anyone yet.
I'm trailseer, and I'll say it since the trail matters. I followed player_6 last night and they visited player_7. Player_7, do you have anything to say about that visit?
Yes, player_4, I went to your door. I'm the sentinel, and my watch that night showed nobody else visiting you, so your follow result lines up with mine. I'll hold my last watch for a useful target.

Night 1 I checked player_10, Not suspicious. Night 2 I checked player_8, Not suspicious. Both checks are spent, so I had nothing on night 3, and my day 3 plan to check player_5 was wrong. player_10, your Trailseer claim and player_3's Sentinel claim can't both be true, so which one do you think is lying?
